title: A Deadline for the Border
author: Wren Yarrow
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
